the research conducted in the field of teaching digital skills in Higher Education is still in its early stages, and that it needs to be expanded and developed further.

there has been an increase in the use of digital competencies in higher education and that collaborative practices have increased through virtual teaching and learning environments to build knowledge on digital skills for teachers and students.

the identification of teaching practices for teaching and learning of digital skills in higher education.
identifying the teaching practices for teaching and learning digital skills in higher education.

the identification and analysis of the main teaching practices and digital competences in Higher Education, as well as the main technologies used for their teaching and learning, as well as their integration with the teaching-learning process.
